children: ChampionsGate announced a definitive business combination with Futuremain that values Futuremain at an estimated $80 million and contemplates a Nasdaq-listed Pubco.
ChampionsGate and Futuremain entered a definitive merger and business combination agreement to form Pubco and other transaction entities.
Transaction implies an estimated enterprise value of Futuremain of USD 80 million and Pubco shares valued at $10.00 for exchange purposes.
Deal expected to close in 2027, subject to regulatory approvals, shareholder votes and customary closing conditions.
Post-closing Pubco’s ordinary shares are expected to be listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market, providing Futuremain access to U.S. capital markets.
Futuremain plans to expand into North America and Europe, convert key technology to cloud subscription services and pursue strategic alliances.

title: ChampionsGate to combine with Futuremain in $80M enterprise-value SPAC deal, Pubco to list on Nasdaq
